movie.title: Hacksaw Ridge
movie.overview: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.

facts: Did you know 'Hacksaw Ridge' isn't just a biographical drama? It actually drew its inspiration from a 2004 documentary titled 'The Conscientious Objector'!
Desmond Doss's unwavering refusal to carry a weapon wasn't just a personal choice; it was deeply rooted in his faith as a Seventh-day Adventist.
For those curious about the production, 'Hacksaw Ridge' was filmed entirely in Australia! Principal photography took place from September to December 2015.
